conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Common disadvantages include intermittency due to weather and night, and the initial upfront cost of installation. The energy storage solutions for solar can also be a challenge.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Many are exploring advanced battery storage, pumped-hydro storage, and even hydrogen production to store excess solar energy for later use. Smart grids and forecasting also help manage solar's variable output.
